subject: pthm-nrqm-potentials-delta-point-interaction-bound-state
detail: items/pthm-nrqm-potentials-delta-point-interaction-bound-state.md:118, Facts & Assumptions [F2], trailing scaled-operator clause: F2 claims for every real α that (ℏ²/2m)A_α has ψ_α as an eigenvector with eigenvalue −ℏ²α²/(8m), without restricting this eigenpair claim to α<0. The current source theorem thm-nrqm-intervals-delta-unique-bound-state defines this normalized bound state and proves its eigenvalue only for α<0; for α≥0 it states there is no negative eigenvalue. The batch-51 proof uses the scaled eigenpair only for g<0, so its conclusions remain supported, but the extra fact in F2 is false or undefined outside that range. Restrict the scaled eigenvector clause to α<0.

subject: lem-nrqm-uncertainty-bounded-borel-calculus-of-commuting-operators
detail: Proof, step 7.1, when uniqueness of the spectral PVM is invoked.: The proof establishes that F(Λ)=E_A(f⁻¹(Λ)) is a PVM, but does not establish that F is regular before invoking uniqueness to identify it with the spectral PVM of f(A). The cited thm-spectral-theorem-for-unbounded-self-adjoint-operators gives uniqueness among regular PVMs. Regularity follows because each scalar F-measure is finite Borel on ℝ; cite thm-locally-finite-borel-measures-are-regular-when-open-sets-are-sigma-compact and add the prerequisite, or prove regularity locally. Clause (c) is unproved as written; clause (a), used by the assigned joint-PVM criterion, is unaffected.
